QuestInfo.name: [Destiny Weapon] A New Level of Mastery
QuestInfo.0:
After you awakened the Destiny Weapon, Zigang tells you that further tempering can enhance the weapon to new heights.

#r* Accept the [Destiny Weapon] Adversary's Conviction quest to open the Destiny Weapon window. There, you can view quest details and continue the story.#k
QuestInfo.1:
Go to Zigang at the Four Seasons Pavilion in Shangri-La to receive guidance.

#r* Accept the [Destiny Weapon] Adversary's Conviction quest to open the Destiny Weapon window. There, you can view quest details and continue the story.#k
QuestInfo.2: Zigang said you must surpass those who came before you if the weapon is to recognize you as its true master. Talk to Siyu about the trials ahead.
